title: Strict Fourier weight decrease at successive odd dimensions
statement: Let $m$ and $j$ be nonnegative integers with $j\le m$. The level-$(2j+1)$ Fourier weight of majority on the Boolean cube of dimension $2m+3$ is strictly less than its level-$(2j+1)$ Fourier weight on the Boolean cube of dimension $2m+1$.
